verdict.rationale: GitBook has a first-party docs page titled "Reusable content" [gitbook-docs-26], which supports the reusable-snippet half of the story, but the pack gives only the title and no detail on how synced updates across pages work. Nothing in the pack covers variables. "Content variants" [gitbook-docs-20] is a site-structure feature, not text variables, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: any evidence of variables, detail confirming that edits to reusable blocks sync to every page that uses them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
